questions.stem: A city library is adding a web page where patrons sign in with their card numbers and PINs to renew books. Which of the following protocols should the web server use so this information cannot be read as it travels from patrons' browsers?

reference.title: Secure Protocols
reference.find: Using HTTPS is crucial for protecting

questions.stem: A county is launching a website where residents pay property taxes, and the site will accept only HTTPS connections. Which of the following should the firewall in front of the new web server allow?
A payroll company moves its website from TLS 1.2 to TLS 1.3. Which of the following attacks is TLS 1.3 designed to prevent?

reference.title: Transport Layer Security
reference.find: the ability to perform downgrade attacks

questions.stem: An auditor warns that the passwords a transit agency's apps send when they sign in to its directory server could be sniffed on the internal network. Which of the following should the directory administrator do to BEST protect these sign-ins?

choices.text: Block the LDAP port on the public interface
Require simple binds with a DN and password
Configure LDAPS with a digital certificate
Limit the apps to read-only directory access

reference.title: Secure Directory Services
reference.find: secure tunnel for the user credential

questions.stem: A hospital's directory servers listen on port 389 and accept only SASL binds that use the STARTTLS command. Which of the following BEST describes the staff logons these servers receive?

choices.text: They are encrypted on LDAP's standard port
They are encrypted only after port 636 is opened
They are plaintext, since port 389 carries basic LDAP
They are anonymous, since SASL binds skip credentials

questions.stem: A stadium's new policy requires that SNMP monitoring of its switches be encrypted and that each administrator sign in with a username instead of a shared community name. Which of the following should the network team do to meet the policy?

choices.text: Replace the community name with a hard-to-guess one
Restrict SNMP to two monitoring hosts with an ACL
Move the SNMP service to a nonstandard port
Upgrade to SNMP v3 and disable the older versions

questions.stem: A children's hospital is placing a firewall between its SNMP monitor and the switches that the monitor polls for their statistics. Which of the following must the rule from the monitor to the switches allow?

A genetics lab sends nightly batches of patient test results to a partner clinic's server, and the login and the files must both be protected from eavesdropping. Which of the following protocols should the lab use?

After a print shop installs a new firewall, customers can no longer connect to the shop's SFTP server to upload their print files. Which of the following ports is the new firewall MOST likely blocking?

A school district wants staff email clients to download and manage their mailboxes only through the secured versions of POP3 and IMAP. Which of the following ports should the firewall allow for this mailbox access?

A nonprofit began sending its newsletters through a cloud email service, and receiving mail servers now flag them as forged because the service's IP addresses are not on its list of authorized senders. Which of the following should the nonprofit's administrator update?

reference.title: Email Security
reference.find: list of authorized sending IP addresses

questions.stem: Attackers have been changing the bank details in invoices that a supplier emails to a construction company, so the supplier's mail server now digitally signs every message it sends. Which of the following should the construction company's mail server use to check these signatures?

reference.title: Email Security
reference.find: DKIM record in the sender's DNS

questions.stem: To fight spoofing, a credit union wants receiving mail servers to quarantine messages that falsely claim to come from its domain and to send it reports showing which systems send mail in its name. Which of the following should the credit union configure?

Staff at a school district keep receiving spam, phishing links, and harmful attachments, so the district wants one control point that inspects every incoming message and removes these threats before they reach inboxes. Which of the following should the district deploy?

An insurance agency finds that an employee who is about to quit has been emailing customer files that contain Social Security numbers to a personal email account. Which of the following would BEST stop more of these files from being sent out?

choices.text: Apply DLP rules to outgoing email

questions.stem: To comply with PCI DSS, a sporting goods retailer adds DLP rules to its email system. Which of the following will these rules BEST stop?

choices.text: A clerk emailing a customer's full card number to a vendor
A phishing email that links to a fake card-payment page
An attachment that installs malware when an employee opens it
A forged email that claims to come from the retailer's card processor

exhibit.text:

questions.stem: After several employees at an architecture firm visit malware distribution sites from web search results, the IT team wants every device on the office network to be unable to reach known malicious domains. Which of the following would BEST meet this goal?

reference.title: DNS Filtering
reference.find: blocking access to known phishing sites

questions.stem: An attacker typed part of a SQL statement into the pet search box on an animal shelter's adoption website and deleted every pet listing in its database. Which of the following should the shelter's developers do to BEST prevent this attack?

choices.text: Encrypt the site's database at rest
Use secure cookies for all visitor sessions
Require HTTPS for all of the site's pages
Allow only input that fits expected values

questions.stem: A researcher in a bike-share company's bug bounty program reports that the request shown made the rental website list the files in its server's root folder. Which of the following would BEST stop this attack?

reference.title: Secure Coding Techniques
reference.find: addresses the issue of untrusted input

questions.stem: A penetration test shows that a concert ticket seller's web application is open to session hijacking and to cross-site scripting. Which of the following techniques should be added to the application to stop these attacks?

Before installing a free screen recorder, a technician confirms that its installer has a valid digital signature with a certificate from a trusted CA. Which of the following does this check prove about the program?

choices.text: It is free of bugs and security vulnerabilities
It contains no malicious code from its author
It is from the publisher it claims and is unchanged
It passed static code analysis before release

reference.title: Secure Coding Techniques
reference.find: Code signing serves a dual purpose

questions.stem: Customers keep reporting security flaws in each new release of a fitness-tracking app, so its developers want to catch such flaws while they are still writing the code. Which of the following BEST meets this goal?

reference.title: Secure Coding Techniques
reference.find: critical because it enables early detection

questions.stem: An insurance company has its staff use a web browser that runs each tab and extension in its own sandbox. Which of the following BEST describes how this protects the company's computers?

choices.text: It blocks lookups of known malicious domain names
It stops malicious code from reaching the operating system
It encrypts the traffic between the browser and each website
It stops sensitive data from leaving through web forms
